insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured options: INR 2 Lacs to INR 6 Crores (Sum Insured = Base Sum Insured + Super Reload + Super Credit (if applicable) + Cancer Booster (if applicable) etc.)

great.name: Room rent: No limit (At actuals) up to Sum Insured
great.quote:
Room Rent
Actuals up to Sum Insured
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Activ One MAX)
great.explanation: No room category cap like “single room only” or ₹X/day; claims are paid at actuals up to the Sum Insured, which avoids proportionate deductions due to room upgrade.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization: 90 days
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Pre-Hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... for up to 90 days immediately prior to the date of such Hospitalization.
great.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for 90 days before hospitalization—better than the usual 30–60 days.

great.name: Consumables / Non-medical items: Covered (all 4 lists) via Claim Protect
great.quote: Non-payable items will be covered (all 4 lists of Annexure I)
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Claim Protect)
great.explanation: Covers many common out-of-pocket hospital items (gloves, masks, kits, etc.) when Claim Protect applies as per schedule—reduces surprise expenses.

great.name: Restore/Refill: Super Reload (unlimited) after base+super credit exhaustion
great.quote: We shall provide for a reload amounting to the Base Sum Insured (“Super Reload”), unlimited times during the Policy Year
great.explanation: Provides an extra buffer once your Base Sum Insured (and Super Credit, if any) is exhausted, allowing multiple large claims in the same year.

great.name: Built-in Additional Sum Insured buffer: Super Credit (renewal bonus) irrespective of claims (non-resetting)
great.quote:
Super Credit (Increases Irrespective of Claim)
Under this Benefit... (“Super Credit”) will be applied/increased... irrespective of any claims in previous Policy Year
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table + Section C.11 Super Credit
great.explanation: Your available Sum Insured can increase on renewal even if you claimed, which is superior to standard NCB that often resets on a claim.

great.name: Domiciliary hospitalization: Covered
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Medical Expenses incurred during the Policy Period on Domiciliary Hospitalization...
great.explanation: Covers eligible treatment taken at home when hospitalization would otherwise be required (subject to conditions).

great.name: Bariatric surgery / Obesity treatment: Covered (subject to conditions)
great.quote: Obesity Treatment: Medical Expenses incurred... arising out of Hospitalization for a Bariatric Surgery... subject to the conditions... as per Section D.1.6
great.explanation: Bariatric surgery is covered if medical criteria (BMI/co-morbidities etc.) are met.

good.name: Specific illness waiting period: 24 months
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries / treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage...
good.reference: Section D.1.2 Specified disease / procedure Waiting Period (Code-Excl02)
good.explanation: 24 months is standard in the market for listed specific diseases/procedures.

good.name: Initial waiting period: 30 days (except accident)
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: 30-day initial waiting is standard for illnesses (accidents covered from day 1).

bad.name: Post-hospitalization: 180 days (not >180)
bad.quote: for up to 180 days from the date of discharge from the Hospital.
bad.explanation: Post-hospitalization is capped at 180 days; as per the benchmark used here, GREAT is >180 days. (Still a common industry limit.)

unclear.name: Co-pay (default/base plan) not explicitly stated; only optional PPN co-pay described
unclear.quote: Preferred Provider Network (PPN) Discount... If the Insured Person takes treatment... other than those listed as “Preferred Provider Network”, then... shall bear a Co-Payment of 10% on each and every claim...
unclear.reference: Section C.13.5 Preferred Provider Network (PPN) Discount
unclear.explanation: A 10% co-pay applies only if you opt into the PPN discount and use a non-PPN hospital. The document excerpt does not clearly state the default/base co-pay (e.g., 'no co-pay') for the standard plan—confirm from Policy Schedule.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
